misreadings.quote: the lofty boss cannot hear, so the employee must come closer
misreadings.evidence: the boss has trouble hearing, so the employee has to step up quite close to him
misreadings.explanation: The text says the boss has trouble hearing, not that he cannot hear at all.

misreadings.quote: his fantasy of knocking the boss off the desk
misreadings.evidence: I would've gone to the boss and told him just what I think from the bottom of my heart. He would've fallen right off his desk!
misreadings.explanation: Gregor imagines the boss falling off his desk in shock at his speech, not Gregor knocking him off.

result.note: Both versions are almost entirely faithful; the only issues are two small imprecisions in the compressed reflection, and the prose version has none.
